jen: Heads-up — planning a VPC on‑prem airgap catalog refresh tonight 23:00 UTC. small patch set: image-layer fix + installer submanifest update. Need pin policy signoff and rollback criteria.
andre: ack. whats the change window? canary? :eyes:
jen: 23:00–00:30 UTC window. 15-min canary to private lab first, then staged push to customer mirrors. manual gate after canary.
packaging: we built image bundle v1.7.3-preview. checksums attached. Please confirm pin or allow auto-shrinkwrap.
packaging: checksum lines:
```
installer:v1.7.3 sha256:abcd1234ef...7890
airgap-bundle:v1.7.3 sha256:1a2b3c4d...
```
andre: need to be explicit: if any checksum mismatch during mirror publish -> abort and rollback to v1.7.2 with manifest pin. no partial publish.
sre-oncall: agree. Also if deploy-bot reports registry unreachable for >5m during canary -> abort and open incident.
jen: +1. propose conditional pin policy: on successful canary publish to staging -> unpin allowed and release notes updated; else pin back to previous manifest and notify customers.
release-bot: :package: preflight started — validating manifests and signing keys. status: 3/5 checks passing.
deploy-bot: preflight: pushing submanifest to mirror-staging. progress: 42%.
packaging: quick note — we rotated the cosign key yesterday; release-bot validated new key fingerprint: cosign:SHA256:aa:bb:cc
andre: ensure release notes mention cosign rotation and KMS rotation note. customers need upgrade notes for offline install: run `redwood-installer verify --manifest <manifest>` after download.
jen: rollback playbook in short:
1) stop publish
2) revert manifest pointer to v1.7.2
3) republish mirror metadata
4) run `installer --verify` across sample nodes
5) notify CS + oncall
sre-oncall: can someone paste the single-command revert? saves time during an incident.
packaging: revert command:
```
redwood-manifest set-pointer --env airgap --manifest v1.7.2 --reason "auto-rollback from v1.7.3 publish failure"
```
andre: and follow with `release-bot notify --channel customer-notify --template rollback` to trigger emails.
release-bot: preflight now 5/5 ✅ signatures ok. ready for canary at 23:05 UTC.
jen: canary go/no-go in 2 min. tagging @sre-oncall @andre for final checks.
sre-oncall: go from oncall side. will watch metrics and mirror logs. :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary publish started -> mirror-staging (task_id: mb-2155-1). ETA ~7m.
andre: monitoring rule: if mirror latency > 2s or error rate > 1% for 5m -> abort.
jen: documenting this thread in release notes draft. after canary and no issues we'll proceed. if anything odd, follow rollback playbook above and escalate.
sre-oncall: noting runbook entry and paging schedule.
packaging: final reminder — update private-installer SHA in the installation guide after full push.
jen: thanks all. will post final status when full push completes or if rollback triggers. :thumbsup:
